Last Lamp Out.name: Last Lamp Out
Last Lamp Out.description: Signature move. The companion bounds through the user's blaze and spreads it across a four-meter pool of shade. For two turns the black tongues drink nearby lamplight, hiding anyone inside from watchers outside. Flames clinging to a chosen object in the pool deal heavy fire damage. Direct sun or a floodlight cuts the pool apart. Strain: severe.
